caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a high, rectangular backrest that has a decorative curved top and finials at both upper corners. The backrest consists of a woven cane material framed by the wood, which is light brown. The chair’s legs and supports are turned with a series of rounded and spindle-like shapes, and they are joined by stretchers, including one curved stretcher in the front. The seat of the chair is square and appears to be cushioned, covered with a light-colored fabric that has a floral and leaf pattern with colors including muted reds, greens, and browns. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a detail of the fabric design, showing a portion of the same flora with clear lines, red and pink flowers, green foliage, and fine stems. The drawing is set within a double-lined rectangular border on a cream-colored background.
title: Side Chair
